title: Minehub
description: A Minecraft minigames server with many unique minigames
body:
# Minehub
Minehub is a minigames server with many unqiue gamemodes. It features many emotes, cosmetics and enhancements that can be earned or purchased, as well as a realistic economy with an auction house where you can buy and sell items.

Minehub also has regular content and quality of life updates, twice per season. Each season lasts around 10 weeks.

## Gamemodes

### ![Parkour Tag game icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5c9ad7b578e09c1f7ceecb7d7c9ae13b7d0278f_0.webp) Parkour Tag
Take turns as a hunter in a point-based game where you play a game of tag with 3 other players!

### ![Spleef Royale game icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f00505cf0009a371b9be6ba6572e7396afdf5206_0.webp) Spleef Royale
Modernized spleef with unique items to help you be the last person standing! Be careful of game events that will shake up the game and cause chaos!

### ![One Shot game icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0271b3d959e077d84e2e4860b1e86cd5666bc81e_0.webp) One Shot
Fight for kills and ONE SHOT everyone in your path! Collect powerups that help you reach the top!

### ![Survival Games game icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ca9e675a1749c4f86ed3a88aedb99f3bd859a26.webp) Survival Games
Drop in, loot up, and fight your way to a win in our modernized Survival Games!

### ![Pacer game icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf6ae1c1d65471fc10b0ce9dbf0b945cc59bea4a.png) Pacer
Parkour your way through courses that get more difficult as you play! Each completed course gives you a point, and 3 failures eliminates you!

### ![Mob Mayhem game icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19ea5f2e8fda671ab83be2ac0304353b75e07556.webp) Mob Mayhem
A Super Smash Bros style minigame: Pick a mob, fight other mobs, last mob standing wins!

### ![Mosaic game icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/223a43f1a9630876b7ad152b51f3436a9c91814a.png) Mosaic **(NEW!)**
Replicate the center build as many times as you can in the time limit to win!
